diagnosis: The GetPerformanceReview method loads employee performance review records using an un-scoped sqlx query on reviewID. Any authenticated employee in the organization can read colleagues' private performance ratings, disciplinary feedback, and manager evaluations.

GET /api/reviews/rev_9921 HTTP/1.1
Host: talent.company-portal.net
